_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Finding the Light#000.src: What you have done may not have been the right thing, by anyone's account. However, it was necessary. You have thrown off your bonds, in a sense.
Finding the Light#000.dst: 誰から見ても正しい行いではなかったかもしれぬ。だが、必要だった。ある意味、お前は己の枷を振り払ったのだ。

Finding the Light#001.src: New Quest Started: Realm of Light IV - Finding the Light
Finding the Light#001.dst: 新しいクエスト開始: 光の領域 IV - 光を求めて

Finding the Light#002.src: That should have cracked open the foundation! You should check to see if you can reach the archive mentioned by the note card.
Finding the Light#002.dst: 今ので土台が割れたはずだ！メモのカードにあった書庫へ行けるか確かめよう。

Finding the Light#003.src: The door down below should open, now that you've activated the mechanisms.
Finding the Light#003.dst: 仕掛けを作動させたので、下の扉が開くはずだ。

Finding the Light#004.src: Some of the few pages are ripped out. It seems to be describing an event occurring with the Guardian of the Forest until the first missing page.
Finding the Light#004.dst: 何ページか破り取られている。最初の欠けたページまでは、森の守護者に起きた出来事が書かれているようだ。

Finding the Light#005.src: The rest of the book is in perfect condition- Who could've done this if the archives were locked away? Did someone enter before you?
Finding the Light#005.dst: 本の残りは無傷だ。書庫が封じられていたなら誰の仕業だ？先に誰かが入ったのか？

Finding the Light#006.src: ...so it returned, asleep and unwakeable. The light has spoken of a time when the Guardian shall grace us with its presence once more...
Finding the Light#006.dst: …こうしてそれは戻り、眠ったまま目覚めなくなった。光は語った、守護者が再び我らの前に現れる時が来ると…

Finding the Light#007.src: ...but such a time is centuries off, and will require great effort. The spell included is vital to the process.
Finding the Light#007.dst: …だがその時は数百年先で、多大な努力を要する。同封の呪文はその過程に不可欠だ。

Finding the Light#008.src: The light also warns- If the darkness should encroach and reach the Guardian's roots, it shall never wake... But it seems we will not have to worry of that.
Finding the Light#008.dst: 光は警告もした。闇が迫り守護者の根に達すれば、二度と目覚めぬと…だが、その心配はなさそうだ。

Finding the Light#009.src: There's another loose page here, with more High Gavellian text on it. Lari should be able to translate this.
Finding the Light#009.dst: ここにも破れたページがあり、高位 Gavel 語が書かれている。Lari なら訳せるはずだ。

Finding the Light#010.src: ...go on, then, do it. I'm just needed here to be a translator for you thus far, it seems.
Finding the Light#010.dst: …さあ、やって。今のところ、私はあなたの通訳でしかないみたいね。

Finding the Light#012.src: The voice of the Light told you to pursue her. You shouldn't stop now, should you?
Finding the Light#012.dst: 光の声は彼女を追えと告げた。今さら止まるわけにはいかないだろう？

Finding the Light#013.src: The building looks climbable... You can probably eavesdrop on the conversation if you climb up the walls.
Finding the Light#013.dst: この建物は登れそうだ…壁を登れば、会話を盗み聞きできるかもしれない。

Finding the Light#014.dst: 出てって！とにかく…出てって。

Finding the Light#015.src: You got the plant! You should return by the Guardian of the Forest to proceed.
Finding the Light#015.dst: 植物を手に入れた！森の守護者のもとへ戻って先へ進もう。

Finding the Light#016.src: I DON'T CARE ANYMORE! STOP STEALING MY LIFE LIKE THIS!!!
Finding the Light#016.dst: もうどうでもいい！こんなふうに私の人生を奪わないで！！！

Finding the Light#018.src: ...GRAAAAAUGH!! TELL ME HOW THIS IS "ENOUGH!" TELL ME, NOW!
Finding the Light#018.dst: …ぐああああっ！！これのどこが「十分」なの！今すぐ答えて！

Finding the Light#019.src: To do something "dark," you are about to say, and to that I say you have not.
Finding the Light#019.dst: 「闇」に手を染めた、と言うのだろう。だがそうではない。

Finding the Light#020.src: For a thousand years or more of your own thoughts, I understand that you are conflicted.
Finding the Light#020.dst: 千年以上も独りで考え続けたのだ。迷うのも無理はない。

Finding the Light#021.src: However... You have, in that time, made a grave error. You have grown to realize an incorrect assumption.
Finding the Light#021.dst: だが…その間にお前は重大な過ちを犯した。誤った思い込みを真実と信じたのだ。

Finding the Light#022.src: Dark and Light... They oppose. They clash. They create a cloying pox. But, allow me to ask.
Finding the Light#022.dst: 闇と光…両者は対立し、衝突し、息苦しい病を生む。だが、問わせてほしい。

Finding the Light#023.src: Is the axe evil for chopping the tree? Is the wood evil for resisting the metal?
Finding the Light#023.dst: 木を切る斧は悪か？金属に抗う木は悪か？

Finding the Light#024.src: Are the flames evil for burning up the leaves? Is the water evil for dousing the fire?
Finding the Light#024.dst: 葉を焼く炎は悪か？火を消す水は悪か？

Finding the Light#025.src: Is a victim evil for striking back against those that have struck them?
Finding the Light#025.dst: 自分を傷つけた者に反撃する被害者は悪か？

Finding the Light#026.src: And most importantly... Are any of these things light, or dark?
Finding the Light#026.dst: そして何より…これらのうち、光はどれで、闇はどれだ？

Finding the Light#027.src: I will not ask you to. You must understand that Orphion has no moral bearings- He simply needs action.
Finding the Light#027.dst: 無理にとは言わぬ。Orphion に善悪の基準はないと知るのだ。彼はただ行動を求めている。

Finding the Light#028.src: I admit, such a thing is a conundrum. I agree that it is a tragedy to kill, in many instances.
Finding the Light#028.dst: 確かに難問だ。多くの場合、殺すことは悲劇だと私も思う。

Finding the Light#029.src: Yet when such an action could save the lives of others, it becomes a conundrum with no answer. An impossible value to weigh.
Finding the Light#029.dst: だがその行いが他者の命を救うなら、答えのない難問となる。量りようのない重さだ。

Finding the Light#030.src: Despite the circumstances, you have done the best you could. I cannot fault you for your thoughts and morals.
Finding the Light#030.dst: あの状況で、お前は最善を尽くした。その考えも良心も責められはせぬ。

Finding the Light#031.src: And so... As you are now proven, as I am awoken, the gateway to the Light shall reveal itself to you. Lari... You must prepare for your journey to the Realm of Light.
Finding the Light#031.dst: そして…お前が証を立て、私が目覚めた今、光への門が姿を現すだろう。Lari…光の領域への旅に備えるのだ。

Finding the Light#032.src: I do not blame you for it. By the time you have composed yourself, your ally will be ready. Understand that they are as necessary as you are.
Finding the Light#032.dst: お前を責めはせぬ。心が落ち着く頃には、仲間の準備も整っていよう。彼らもお前と同じく欠かせぬ存在なのだ。

Finding the Light#033.src: I must ask you to pay close attention. I shall present it simply- though the enormity of this cannot be understated.
Finding the Light#033.dst: よく聞いてほしい。簡潔に話そう。事の重大さは言い尽くせぬがな。

Finding the Light#034.src: This is our world, the world we stand in right now. The physical plane of existence.
Finding the Light#034.dst: これが我らの世界、今立っている世界。存在の物質界だ。

Finding the Light#035.src: Only a select few are aware that there is more of the world than this. Even the astronomers and those who view the enormity of the sky cannot understand.
Finding the Light#035.dst: これ以上の世界があると知る者はごく僅かだ。広大な空を眺める天文学者でさえ理解できぬ。

Finding the Light#036.src: For, you see, this realm, this plane- It is mirrored upon a second plane, as the embodiments of Realms clash.
Finding the Light#036.dst: この界は第二の界に映し出されている。そこで諸領域の化身がぶつかり合うのだ。

Finding the Light#037.src: This is the Plane of Influence, comprised of many realms. There are three you must know- But only one you must pay attention to.
Finding the Light#037.dst: それが影響界、多くの領域から成る界だ。知るべきは三つ。だが注意すべきは一つだけだ。

Finding the Light#038.src: The Realms of Influence are connected to the physical plane, tied inexorably so to it. This is why even those gazing at the cosmos cannot grasp the enormity of it.
Finding the Light#038.dst: 影響の領域は物質界と切っても切れぬほど結びついている。ゆえに宇宙を見つめる者にも全容は掴めぬ。

Finding the Light#039.src: These realms are in a constant push and pull- Battles that could not be seen by those of this world, waged constantly.
Finding the Light#039.dst: これらの領域は絶えず押し合い引き合っている。この世界の者には見えぬ戦いが続いているのだ。

Finding the Light#040.src: However, they can be felt. Wide-scale changes to the balance of one realm or another are reflected on the physical plane.
Finding the Light#040.dst: だが、感じ取ることはできる。いずれかの領域の均衡が大きく揺らげば、物質界にも表れる。

Finding the Light#041.src: The Realms of Influence are, themselves, reflections of a Beast- They themselves, a physical manifestation of their realm, as their realm is a manifestation of them.
Finding the Light#041.dst: 影響の領域そのものが、ある獣の映し身だ。獣はその領域の具現であり、領域もまた獣の具現なのだ。

Finding the Light#042.src: So surely, you must know- As Gavel has decayed, it must mean that the Realm of Light is in peril, and thus that Orphion is, as well.
Finding the Light#042.dst: ならば分かるだろう。Gavel が腐朽した以上、光の領域は危機にあり、Orphion もまた危ういのだ。

Finding the Light#043.src: The Light is infected- That abominable parasite has breached the Realm of Light, and sought Orphion to leech away his light.
Finding the Light#043.dst: 光は侵されている。あの忌まわしき寄生体が光の領域に入り込み、Orphion の光を吸い取ろうとしている。

Finding the Light#044.src: And so, as the sun is forced to set, the land of Gavel grows dark. As the dark parasites spread and devour the minds of those here, so too is Orphion subject to this torture.
Finding the Light#044.dst: ゆえに陽は沈まされ、Gavel の地は暗くなってゆく。闇の寄生体が人々の心を喰らうように、Orphion もまた同じ責め苦を受けている。

Finding the Light#045.src: Now, you must enter the Realm of Light, and aid Lari in purging the parasite, before its work is finished and Orphion's mind is consumed.
Finding the Light#045.dst: さあ、光の領域へ入り、Lari と共に寄生体を祓うのだ。その企みが成り、Orphion の心が喰い尽くされる前に。

Finding the Light#046.src: You must ready yourself before this, of course. To venture to another realm is a lofty task.
Finding the Light#046.dst: 無論、その前に備えねばならぬ。別の領域へ赴くのは大事業だ。

Finding the Light#047.src: I will bestow upon you two things that will surely aid you in this, however. First, I shall provide you the way to the Gateway to Light.
Finding the Light#047.dst: だが、きっと助けとなるものを二つ授けよう。まずは、光への門への道を示す。

Finding the Light#048.src: Once you have reached it, I shall bestow upon you a personal blessing of mine, in the hopes that your path will become clear.
Finding the Light#048.dst: そこに辿り着いたなら、私自らの祝福を授けよう。お前の道が明らかになるように。

Finding the Light#049.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} で Lari を見つける。

Finding the Light#050.dst: 目覚めて！導きが必要なの！
Finding the Light#050.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#051.src: ...ah. {u}. So you are needed here too, then?
Finding the Light#051.dst: …あら。{u}。ここでもあなたが必要とされてるってわけ？
Finding the Light#051.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#052.src: I am... TRYING... To awaken the Guardian of the Forest to receive its guidance, but it refuses to budge! Even the voice of Orphion provides no reaction.
Finding the Light#052.dst: 私は…必死に…森の守護者を目覚めさせて導きを得ようとしてるのに、びくともしない！Orphion の声にすら反応しないの。
Finding the Light#052.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#053.src: I beg once more of you, awaken! Us two... Us two seek your wisdom!
Finding the Light#053.dst: もう一度お願い、目覚めて！私たち二人は…あなたの知恵を求めてるの！
Finding the Light#053.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#054.src: I present you Orphion's barest light- Please, respond!
Finding the Light#054.dst: Orphion のかすかな光を捧げます。どうか、応えて！
Finding the Light#054.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#055.src: Urgh... See? Nothing is happening. I'm at a loss of what to do. Maybe you can affect some change, considering what you've done before.
Finding the Light#055.dst: うう…ほらね？何も起きない。もうどうしたらいいか分からない。今までのあなたなら、何か変えられるかも。
Finding the Light#055.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#056.src: My pulse, it is time. I shall shine my light upon the roots of the Guardian. You and she must learn now.
Finding the Light#056.dst: 我が脈動よ、時は来た。守護者の根に我が光を照らそう。お前と彼女は、今こそ学ばねばならぬ。

Finding the Light#057.src: Read the inscription at the bottom of the big tree.
Finding the Light#057.dst: 大樹の根元の碑文を読む。

Finding the Light#058.src: An inscription! That wasn't there before! It was... That was completely instant. How did you even...?
Finding the Light#058.dst: 碑文だわ！さっきまでなかったのに！それが…一瞬で現れた。一体どうやって…？
Finding the Light#058.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#059.src: But, still! I knew I could be useful, let me translate this for you! As a stranger to Gavel you wouldn't know High Gavellian...
Finding the Light#059.dst: でも、とにかく！私だって役に立てる、訳してあげる！Gavel のよそ者に高位 Gavel 語は分からないでしょうし…
Finding the Light#059.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#060.src: It says... Secrets uncovered in the oldest of libraries in {p}.
Finding the Light#060.dst: こう書いてある…秘密は {p} で最も古い図書館で明かされる、と。
Finding the Light#060.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#061.src: ...of course. A place that Elves aren't allowed, but humans are. {u}, you'll have to find this library on your own, it seems.
Finding the Light#061.dst: …そういうこと。エルフは入れないけど、人間は入れる場所。{u}、この図書館は自分で探すしかなさそうね。
Finding the Light#061.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#062.src: Find the Church Library in the city of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Finding the Light#062.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] にある {p} の街で教会の図書館を見つける。

Finding the Light#063.src: Find a way up to the church bell at the top of the church.
Finding the Light#063.dst: 教会の頂上にある鐘まで登る方法を探す。

Finding the Light#064.src: Explore the secret library and find a way to wake up the tree.
Finding the Light#064.dst: 秘密の図書館を探索し、木を目覚めさせる方法を見つける。

Finding the Light#065.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Lari のもとへ戻る

Finding the Light#066.src: Do you reject the light of Orphion? Waken, please!
Finding the Light#066.dst: Orphion の光を拒むというの？お願い、目覚めて！
Finding the Light#066.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#067.src: Urgh... {u}, please tell me you were able to make some progress. The Guardian still refuses... To... WAKE!
Finding the Light#067.dst: うう…{u}、何か進展があったと言って。守護者はまだ…全然…目覚めない！
Finding the Light#067.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#068.src: What is this? A spell scroll- Of the Waking Forest?! In {p}, of all places? Where it would have been... Impossible for me to go...
Finding the Light#068.dst: これは何？呪文の巻物…目覚めの森の？！よりによって {p} で？私には…とても行けない場所なのに…
Finding the Light#068.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#069.src: So I am Orphion's chosen, yet I would not have been able to do what was asked of me. That... No, I can't dwell on that, let me see the scroll.
Finding the Light#069.dst: 私は Orphion に選ばれたのに、頼まれたことすらできなかったのね。それは…いえ、考えても仕方ない。巻物を見せて。
Finding the Light#069.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#070.src: ...hm. It says, The seeker must rest these words upon those of the Guardian.
Finding the Light#070.dst: …ふむ。求める者はこの言葉を守護者の言葉の上に置くべし、と。
Finding the Light#070.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#071.src: I suppose that means you need to place it by the inscription. So yet another task that you must finish...
Finding the Light#071.dst: つまり、碑文のそばに置けってことね。またあなたがやらなきゃいけない仕事か…
Finding the Light#071.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#072.src: ...go on, then, do it. I'm just needed here to be a translator for you thusfar, it seems.
Finding the Light#072.dst: …どうぞ、やって。今のところ私はただの通訳みたいだし。
Finding the Light#072.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#073.src: Use the spell on the inscription under the tree.
Finding the Light#073.dst: 木の下の碑文に呪文を使う。

Finding the Light#074.src: Let me go ahead and read this, too. This will be tedious, I fear...
Finding the Light#074.dst: これも読ませて。骨が折れそうだけど…
Finding the Light#074.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#075.src: It says... Awakening the Guardian of the Forest requires more than just magic. The home of the elves will house the answers and revelations...?
Finding the Light#075.dst: こう書いてある…森の守護者を目覚めさせるには魔法だけでは足りない。エルフの故郷に答えと啓示がある…？
Finding the Light#075.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#076.src: That... This is finally my time! I still have a hand in this!! Finally, I can do something more than just holding stasis here!
Finding the Light#076.dst: それって…ついに私の出番だわ！まだ私にもできることがある！！ここで現状を保つだけじゃなく、やっと何かができる！
Finding the Light#076.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#077.src: Listen, {u}. Achara... This is my time. I can finally help you more directly. I know the elders of {p}- They're sure to have answers!
Finding the Light#077.dst: 聞いて、{u}。Achara…今度は私の番。やっと直接あなたを助けられる。{p} の長老たちを知ってるの。きっと答えをくれるわ！
Finding the Light#077.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#078.src: You truly have been helpful, even through my own worries. I must thank you, but you can relax now! I will be the one this time!
Finding the Light#078.dst: 私が悩んでる間も、あなたは本当に助けてくれた。感謝してる。でももう休んでいいわ！今回は私がやる！
Finding the Light#078.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#079.src: You can continue doing...whatever else it is you need doing. I have seen you helping in various places- Concern yourself with those for now. I can handle this.
Finding the Light#079.dst: あなたは…他にやるべきことをやってて。いろんな場所で人助けしてるのを見てきたわ。今はそっちに専念して。ここは私に任せて。
Finding the Light#079.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#080.src: Pursue her, my pulse. She must take dire action- Alone, her light shall illuminate nothing. You must provide her direction.
Finding the Light#080.dst: 彼女を追え、我が脈動よ。彼女は決死の行動をとらねばならぬ。独りではその光は何も照らさぬ。道を示してやれ。

Finding the Light#081.src: Enter the portal Lari left behind
Finding the Light#081.dst: Lari が残したポータルに入る

Finding the Light#082.src: Go to the hut Lari entered.
Finding the Light#082.dst: Lari が入った小屋へ行く。

Finding the Light#083.src: W-What? You- Why did you follow me? I can handle this! I can finally be useful again! Do you...not trust me?
Finding the Light#083.dst: な、何？あなた…なんでついて来たの？私ならやれる！やっとまた役に立てるのに！私を…信用してないの？
Finding the Light#083.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#084.src: Please, just respect my wishes! If I need your help, I'll go find you- For now, just leave! You don't need to worry about this!
Finding the Light#084.dst: お願い、私の意思を尊重して！助けが要るなら私から探しに行く。今は帰って！あなたが心配することじゃない！
Finding the Light#084.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#085.src: Find a way to sneak into the hut.
Finding the Light#085.dst: 小屋に忍び込む方法を探す。

Finding the Light#086.src: ...if this human has truly done what you have said, then why do you spurn their aid? It is unlike you.
Finding the Light#086.dst: …この人間が本当にお前の言う通りのことを成したなら、なぜ助けを拒む？お前らしくもない。
Finding the Light#086.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#087.src: I know, I know. I just am in disbelief. They've been contacted by Orphion himself, allowed into the Taproot, they have a symbol of Orphion's blessing!!
Finding the Light#087.dst: 分かってる、分かってるわ。ただ信じられないの。Orphion 本人に呼ばれて、Taproot にも入れて、Orphion の祝福の印まで持ってるのよ！！
Finding the Light#087.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#088.src: They just...walked up, after a thousand years of my putting my entire life into trying to save this province, and do everything I couldn't, in the span of weeks at most!
Finding the Light#088.dst: あの人は…ふらっと現れて、私が千年も人生を捧げてこの州を救おうとしてきたのに、私にできなかったことを数週間で全部やってのけたのよ！
Finding the Light#088.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#089.src: Do you understand how infuriating this is? Can you comprehend such a thing, not having been in my position yourself?
Finding the Light#089.dst: これがどれだけ腹立たしいか分かる？私の立場になったこともないのに、分かるっていうの？
Finding the Light#089.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#090.src: No. I cannot understand. But I also cannot understand how you are not grateful for this aid.
Finding the Light#090.dst: いや。分からぬ。だが、なぜこの助けに感謝せぬのかも分からぬ。
Finding the Light#090.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#091.src: I know I should be! It's all I've been able to think about. I should be ecstatic! The light will be saved, it should be everything I've dreamed of...
Finding the Light#091.dst: 感謝すべきなのは分かってる！ずっとそればかり考えてた。大喜びするべきなの！光は救われる、夢見たことそのものなのに…
Finding the Light#091.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#092.src: But it makes me feel like a complete failure. Like everything I have done has been for naught, that I have somehow been doing everything wrong!
Finding the Light#092.dst: でも、自分がまるで役立たずに思えるの。私のしてきたことが全部無駄で、ずっと何もかも間違えてたみたいで！
Finding the Light#092.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#093.src: I know I have made mistakes. Dullahan would still be... Still be himself, if I had taken faster action, but I can't have done nothing right. I can't accept that.
Finding the Light#093.dst: 過ちを犯したのは分かってる。私が早く動いていれば、Dullahan は今も…彼自身のままだった。でも何ひとつ正しくなかったなんて、受け入れられない。
Finding the Light#093.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#094.src: This is my chance to prove I can still be useful- that Orphion choosing me wasn't a fluke! Please, the inscription said you would know where to go!
Finding the Light#094.dst: これはまだ役に立てると証明するチャンスなの。Orphion が私を選んだのはまぐれじゃないって！お願い、碑文には長老なら行き先が分かるって！
Finding the Light#094.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#096.src: ...even after a millennium, there is so very much for us all to learn. Fine then.
Finding the Light#096.dst: …千年経っても、我らには学ぶことが山ほどある。よかろう。
Finding the Light#096.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#097.src: But promise me to accept the aid you receive. This opportunity cannot be wasted, Lari.
Finding the Light#097.dst: だが、差し伸べられた助けは受け入れると約束せよ。この機会を無駄にはできぬぞ、Lari。
Finding the Light#097.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#098.src: ...I have to do at least one thing right. I can't just keep up this holding pattern. I'll do whatever is necessary!
Finding the Light#098.dst: …せめて一つくらい正しいことをしなきゃ。いつまでも足踏みしてられない。必要なことは何でもする！
Finding the Light#098.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#099.src: You must seek the Canned Abis plant, then. It rests within a cavern shaded by giant fern leaves.
Finding the Light#099.dst: ならば Canned Abis という植物を探すのだ。巨大なシダの葉に覆われた洞窟の中にある。
Finding the Light#099.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#100.src: Thank you. I can finally do what I was meant to do! I won't let anything stop me this time!!
Finding the Light#100.dst: ありがとうございます。やっと本来の役目を果たせる！今度は何にも邪魔させない！！
Finding the Light#100.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#101.src: ...Human, I can see you. Consider yourself lucky that she did not. Come talk to me.
Finding the Light#101.dst: …人間よ、見えておるぞ。彼女に見つからなかったのは幸運だったな。こちらへ来て話せ。
Finding the Light#101.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#103.src: So you are Orphion's new chosen, then. It is both surprising and not- Humans have an interesting reputation.
Finding the Light#103.dst: では、お前が Orphion の新たな選ばれし者か。意外でもあり、そうでもない。人間の評判は面白いからな。
Finding the Light#103.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#104.src: Often said as being able to get anything done, without limits, be it completing impossible tasks or breaking moral tenets.
Finding the Light#104.dst: 人間は何でも限りなく成し遂げると言われる。不可能な任務の達成であれ、道徳の戒めを破ることであれ。
Finding the Light#104.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#105.src: In this instance, however, you've both to do. Orphion has commanded it, has he not? And so you must, and for that I apologize.
Finding the Light#105.dst: だが今回は、その両方をせねばならぬ。Orphion が命じたのだろう？ならばやるしかない。そのことは詫びよう。
Finding the Light#105.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#106.src: I have seen Lari's work- And she has done this land a priceless service. Alone, she has kept the Decay from creeping south, and thus the Guardian remains with us.
Finding the Light#106.dst: Lari の働きは見てきた。この地にかけがえのない貢献をした。独りで腐朽の南下を食い止め、ゆえに守護者は今も我らと共にある。
Finding the Light#106.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#107.src: However, her own morals prevent the situation from progressing. She cannot kill- And the source must be exterminated for light to once again fill the land.
Finding the Light#107.dst: だが、彼女自身の道徳が事態の進展を阻んでいる。彼女は殺せぬ。そして再び光でこの地を満たすには、元凶を根絶せねばならぬ。
Finding the Light#107.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#108.src: Orphion's circumstances are dire- And so you must come to understand something. He is above us, in terms of morals. Such concepts do not apply to him.
Finding the Light#108.dst: Orphion の状況は切迫している。ゆえに理解してほしい。道徳において彼は我らの上にいる。そうした概念は当てはまらぬ。
Finding the Light#108.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#109.src: As the embodiment of Light itself, he has no sense of morals- Merely survival and stasis. What he asks of us, many will balk at.
Finding the Light#109.dst: 光そのものの化身として、彼に道徳の感覚はない。あるのは存続と維持のみ。その求めに、多くの者は尻込みしよう。
Finding the Light#109.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#110.src: It is a matter where morals must be set aside... And such a thing is one that Lari cannot abide by, for she has stubbornly clung to them for a thousand years.
Finding the Light#110.dst: 道徳を脇に置かねばならぬ事柄だ…それこそ Lari には受け入れられぬ。千年もの間、頑なにそれにしがみついてきたのだから。
Finding the Light#110.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#111.src: To break them... I will admit, I believe there to be some other way to solve these problems, but the fact of the matter is there simply is no time left.
Finding the Light#111.dst: それを破るとは…正直、他に解決策があるとは思う。だが実のところ、もう時間が残されていないのだ。
Finding the Light#111.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#112.src: She must use the extent of her powers, and while she retains her pacifism that will not happen. I must ask you to follow her, as Orphion would wish.
Finding the Light#112.dst: 彼女は持てる力をすべて使わねばならぬが、不殺を貫く限りそれは叶わぬ。Orphion の望み通り、彼女の後を追ってくれ。
Finding the Light#112.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#113.src: There is, unfortunately, no right to this. There is simply necessity- And there, you must push her to her limits. Seek the cave of the Canned Abis.
Finding the Light#113.dst: 残念ながら、ここに正しさはない。あるのは必要だけだ。そこで彼女を限界まで追い込むのだ。Canned Abis の洞窟を探せ。
Finding the Light#113.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#114.src: It is north-east from here. The entrance is shaded by giant fern leaves. I only pray that this will be enough.
Finding the Light#114.dst: ここから北東だ。入口は巨大なシダの葉に覆われている。これで足りることを祈るばかりだ。
Finding the Light#114.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#115.src: Find the Canned Abis cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Finding the Light#115.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Canned Abis の洞窟を見つける

Finding the Light#116.src: Find the plant inside the cave.
Finding the Light#116.dst: 洞窟の中で植物を見つける。

Finding the Light#118.src: ...I can't believe this. What am I doing wrong? What is it? There has to be some reason, what IS it?!
Finding the Light#118.dst: …信じられない。私の何がいけないの？何なの？何か理由があるはず、それは何なの？！
Finding the Light#118.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#119.src: There's not another inscription...it's just the same words! What does it mean by "dire actions?!" I've done everything I can think of!
Finding the Light#119.dst: 新しい碑文もない…同じ言葉だけ！「決死の行動」ってどういう意味？！思いつくことは全部やったのに！
Finding the Light#119.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#120.src: ...{u}. I. I have to know. What did Orphion tell you, exactly? I can't stand not knowing any longer. Did he really replace me?
Finding the Light#120.dst: …{u}。わ、私、知りたいの。Orphion はあなたに何て言ったの？もう知らないままなんて耐えられない。本当に私の代わりにされたの？

Finding the Light#121.src: Is- Is this not dire enough? Is poring over you and putting aside my role and pride to someone else not EXTREME enough?!
Finding the Light#121.dst: こ、これじゃまだ足りないの？あなたに縋って、役目もプライドも他人に譲るのが、まだ極端じゃないっていうの？！
Finding the Light#121.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#122.src: .... I. I have to know. What did Orphion tell you, exactly? I can't stand not knowing any longer. Did he really replace me?
Finding the Light#122.dst: …わ、私。どうしても知りたい。Orphion はあなたに何を言ったの？もう知らないままは耐えられない。本当に私は用済みなの？
Finding the Light#122.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#123.src: I can't think of any other reason why everything for me has just...stopped working. Did he? Please, tell me-
Finding the Light#123.dst: 私のすることが全部…うまくいかなくなった理由が他に思いつかない。そうなの？お願い、教えて――
Finding the Light#123.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#124.src: ...wait... You... You have Canned Abis on you!! Where did you get that?!
Finding the Light#124.dst: …待って…あなた…Canned Abis を持ってる！！どこで手に入れたの？！
Finding the Light#124.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#125.src: You... There's no way you would've known that unless you... YOU! You eavesdropped on me!!
Finding the Light#125.dst: あなた…知ってるはずがない、もし…あなた！盗み聞きしてたのね！！
Finding the Light#125.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#126.src: You FOLLOWED ME into the cave even after I asked not to! You... After everything I said!! After you heard all those private thoughts!
Finding the Light#126.dst: 来ないでって頼んだのに、洞窟までついて来たのね！あなた…私があれだけ言ったのに！！私の心の内を全部聞いておきながら！
Finding the Light#126.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#127.src: You STILL decided it was a good idea to come after me! What are you planning to accomplish like this?!
Finding the Light#127.dst: それでもまだ追ってくるのがいい考えだと思ったの！こんなことして何がしたいの？！
Finding the Light#127.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#128.src: What, are you thinking ‘’oh, let's follow the funny elf girl and see her FAIL, OVER and OVER AGAIN!?‘’ IS THAT IT?!
Finding the Light#128.dst: 何、「変なエルフの子が何度も何度も失敗するのを見物しよう」って思ってるの？！そうなの？！
Finding the Light#128.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#129.src: You heard me then!! It's ALL out in the open! I can't succeed! You're there! You're doing everything I couldn't!
Finding the Light#129.dst: やっぱり聞いてたのね！！全部バレてる！私は成功できない！あなたがいる！私にできないことを全部やってる！
Finding the Light#129.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#130.src: I'm NOT a failure! I'm not! I won't be! I refuse to be! You don't GET to watch me flounder and flail!!
Finding the Light#130.dst: 私は役立たずじゃない！違う！そうはならない！絶対に！私がもがいてあがくのを見物なんてさせない！！
Finding the Light#130.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#133.src: Wha- I... What just... What did I...?
Finding the Light#133.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#136.src: ...GRAAAAAUGH!! TELL ME HOW THIS IS ‘’ENOUGH!‘’ TELL ME, NOW!
Finding the Light#136.dst: …ぐああああっ！！これのどこが「十分」なの！今すぐ答えて！
Finding the Light#136.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#137.src: I-I NEARLY KILLED THEM! I JUST BROKE AND DEFILED EVERYTHING I'VE EVER STOOD FOR!!
Finding the Light#137.dst: こ、殺しかけたのよ！私が守ってきたもの全部を、踏みにじって汚したのよ！！
Finding the Light#137.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#138.src: TELL ME!! HOW COULD THIS POSSIBLY BE THE ANSWER?! HOW COULD THIS BE WHAT NEEDED TO HAPPEN?!
Finding the Light#138.dst: 答えて！！どうしてこれが答えなの？！どうしてこうならなきゃいけなかったの？！
Finding the Light#138.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#139.src: WHY WOULD I BE NEEDED TO... To...
Finding the Light#139.dst: なぜ私がこんな…こんな…
Finding the Light#139.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#140.src: T-Trying to murder them because they did what I couldn't isn't dark? How can you possibly think that?!
Finding the Light#140.dst: わ、私にできないことをやったからって殺そうとしたのが、闇じゃないって？どうしてそう思えるの？！
Finding the Light#140.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#141.src: What kind of guardian are you, permissing this kind of violence? How is anything I just did alright?
Finding the Light#141.dst: こんな暴力を許すなんて、どういう守護者なの？今の私のどこが許されるっていうの？
Finding the Light#141.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#142.src: ...you. You can't possibly be saying that what I did was the right thing to do. I refuse to accept that.
Finding the Light#142.dst: …あなた。私のしたことが正しかったなんて、言うはずないわよね。そんなの受け入れない。
Finding the Light#142.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#144.src: ...then... Shouldn't I feel... I don't know. Shouldn't I feel less restrained? Less afraid? More... More free?
Finding the Light#144.dst: …だったら…感じるべきじゃないの…分からない。縛られてない感じとか？怖くないとか？もっと…自由だとか？
Finding the Light#144.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#145.src: If what I've done was what needed to happen, why do I feel like the scum of the earth? Why do I feel so terrible?!
Finding the Light#145.dst: 私のしたことが必要なことだったなら、なぜ自分が最低のクズに思えるの？なぜこんなに苦しいの？！
Finding the Light#145.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#146.src: ...I... I need time to process this. I... Do you understand how difficult this is to hear? To bear?
Finding the Light#146.dst: …私…考える時間が欲しい。私…これを聞くのが、受け止めるのがどれだけつらいか分かる？
Finding the Light#146.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#147.src: My pulse, your light is brilliant... It has shone upon Lari, and soon her light will shine my way...
Finding the Light#147.dst: 我が脈動よ、お前の光は眩い…それは Lari を照らし、やがて彼女の光も我が方へ届くだろう…

Finding the Light#148.src: Enter the roots, and witness the path to my realm. And then, prepare yourself. Muster your most blinding light...
Finding the Light#148.dst: 根に入り、我が領域への道を見届けよ。そして備えよ。最も眩い光を奮い起こすのだ…
